description: Starts or resumes the user's SlabLineage Deal Desk session (call it when the user says "Open SlabLineage Deal Desk", "open Deal Desk" or wants to check deals at a card show). Returns the session, the profit settings and today's budget. While feesConfirmed is false (a new session), before checking any deal show the user the confirmFees line and ask them to confirm or change it, then call update_deal_desk_settings with confirmFees true (and any changes). Deal Desk needs SlabLineage Pro. If the result has alerts, show them to the user before anything else.

name.description: Optional session name, e.g. "Denver Card Show".

name: open_deal_desk
title: Open Deal Desk
